perspective:
I know the other person asked for help finding action movies, said they like both “hard core” and “fun family” action, and specifically named *Abduction* (2011) and *Speed* (1994) with Keanu Reeves as things they love.

They told me they had seen and liked *Mad Max* (1979) but preferred *Mad Max: Fury Road* (2015) with Tom Hardy. They said they could never get into the *Star Wars* movies. They called *Die Hard* (1988) “pretty good” and mentioned Bruce Willis.

I recommended *Mad Max*, *Star Wars: Episode VIII – The Last Jedi* (2017), *Die Hard*, and *Jumanji* (2017). I also mentioned that I had just seen *Jumanji* that weekend.

Finally, they said they were looking for more along the lines of *The Taking of Pelham 123* (2009) or *S.W.A.T.* (2003), and asked whether the new one of “that movie” was good.
